# xhr.dev

> Self-hosted anti-bot solvers that keep working after the vendor's next update.

xhr.dev ships a Docker container that solves anti-bot challenges (Akamai Bot
Manager, DataDome, F5/Shape) entirely inside the customer's own
infrastructure. Traffic, cookies, and tokens never leave the customer's
network -- there is no third-party solving API in the loop, and it works with
outbound internet disabled. Solving happens at the payload level, not by
driving a browser, so a solve takes milliseconds and survives vendors'
routine (non-structural) updates. Pricing is a flat fee for unlimited solves.

- [Getting started](https://docs.xhr.dev/): overview and integration paths
- [Full documentation bundle](https://docs.xhr.dev/llms-full.txt): every docs

- [Deployment](https://docs.xhr.dev/deployment.html)
- [Integrating via MCP](https://docs.xhr.dev/integrate-mcp.html)

- [API reference: Akamai](https://docs.xhr.dev/api-akamai.html)
- [API reference: DataDome](https://docs.xhr.dev/api-datadome.html)
- [API reference: F5 / Shape](https://docs.xhr.dev/api-f5.html)
